page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. Operating on x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system includes 128 GB of dedicated system RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction support covers AVX, AES, and SHA_NI acceleration, while AVX-512 extensions are absent. Networking features an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the instance relies entirely on remote storage, containing zero local disk storage.

Benchmark evaluation shows average multi-core processing capability, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 9518.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 31756.69. Multi-threaded decompression and database operations yield sustained throughput, with Redis SET performance reaching 27.69 million operations per second and static web serving throughput measuring 7.46 GB/sec. A notable architectural tradeoff involves single-core execution speed and uncached large-block memory bandwidth, where read speeds of 35.29 GB/sec and write speeds of 16.62 GB/sec fall into lower benchmark quartiles. Despite these single-threaded constraints, the high core count provides qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized software compilation, middle-tier web servers, enterprise application hosting, and distributed database services.

The balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offers practical cost efficiency for core-dense, parallel workloads such as web serving, software build pipelines, and enterprise application backends.
